alignments.note: The ASV writes the one noun twice, supplying it after Whose and again as the predicate; rule 15 keeps the discontinuous pair in one unit and rule 11 keeps the italicized echo from being mechanically added. Marking t002 added remains defensible.
Rule 9: the imperative auxiliary let and the supplied subject it ride with the verb, headed on the lexical be.
Rule 57: the article governs kosmos across the interposed genitives and takes the English the.
Rule 17: the case preposition of rides with the noun and the noun is the head.
Rule 51: the Greek is anarthrous, so the supplied the is an ordinary helper on the noun.

chrysion names a gold ornament, so jewels of gold renders the one noun; rule 66 makes jewels the generic completion and rule 17 heads a source noun rendered of + noun on the noun. Giving jewels to peritheseos as wearing jewels remains defensible.
Rule 17: on is the English gloss's own particle and of realizes the case; the head is putting.
